sentences.text: The patient was admitted for skilled rehabilitation after surgical repair of a femoral neck fracture.
The skilled admission followed a 4 day inpatient stay.
During the continued stay he received PT 5 days per week along with OT 5 days per week.

sentences.text: Skilled nursing provided daily injections with incision assessment and pain management throughout the stay.

sentences.text: The following week ambulation progressed from 110 to 200 feet with supervision using the walker.
